@[global_simps, irreducible, rust_const "aspis_core::field::P"]
def aspis_core.field.P : Std.U32 := 2147483647#u32

/-- [aspis_core::field::wide_exact::{aspis_core::field::wide_exact::WideExact}::from_limbs]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-core/src/field/wide_exact.rs', lines 207:4-207:69
    Name pattern: [aspis_core::field::wide_exact::{aspis_core::field::wide_exact::WideExact}::from_limbs]
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_fun
  "aspis_core::field::wide_exact::{aspis_core::field::wide_exact::WideExact}::from_limbs"]
def aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs
  (limbs : Array Std.U32 8#usize) :
  Result (Option aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact)
  := do
  let i ← Array.index_usize limbs 0#usize
  if i >= aspis_core.field.P
  then ok none
  else
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize limbs 1#usize
    if i1 >= aspis_core.field.P
    then ok none
    else
      let i2 ← Array.index_usize limbs 2#usize
      if i2 >= aspis_core.field.P
      then ok none
      else
        let i3 ← Array.index_usize limbs 3#usize
        if i3 >= aspis_core.field.P
        then ok none
        else
          let i4 ← Array.index_usize limbs 4#usize
          if i4 >= aspis_core.field.P
          then ok none
          else
            let i5 ← Array.index_usize limbs 5#usize
            if i5 >= aspis_core.field.P
            then ok none
            else
              let i6 ← Array.index_usize limbs 6#usize
              if i6 >= aspis_core.field.P
              then ok none
              else
                let i7 ← Array.index_usize limbs 7#usize
                if i7 >= aspis_core.field.P
                then ok none
                else
                  ok (some
                    {
                      c0 :=
                        { c0 := { a := i, b := i1 }, c1 := { a := i2, b := i3 }
                        },
                      c1 :=
                        {
                          c0 := { a := i4, b := i5 },
                          c1 := { a := i6, b := i7 }
                        }
                    })

@[rust_loop_body]
def host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop0.body
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (quotient : Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.Usize) (Array Std.U32
    8#usize))
  := do
  if i < 8#usize
  then
    let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i)
    let i2 ← Array.index_usize block i1
    let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i2)
    let i4 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i)
    let i5 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i4 1#usize)
    let i6 ← Array.index_usize block i5
    let i7 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i6)
    let i8 ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_shl i7 8#u32)
    let i9 ← lift (i3 ||| i8)
    let i10 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i)
    let i11 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i10 2#usize)
    let i12 ← Array.index_usize block i11
    let i13 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i12)
    let i14 ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_shl i13 16#u32)
    let i15 ← lift (i9 ||| i14)
    let i16 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i)
    let i17 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i16 3#usize)
    let i18 ← Array.index_usize block i17
    let i19 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i18)
    let i20 ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_shl i19 24#u32)
    let i21 ← lift (i15 ||| i20)
    let quotient1 ← Array.update quotient i i21
    let i22 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
    ok (cont (quotient1, i22))
  else ok (done quotient)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::low_base_p_digits]: loop body 2:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 15:8-20:9 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop1_loop0.body
  (quotient : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (remainder : Std.U64) (j : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64 × Std.Usize) ((Array
    Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64))
  := do
  if j > 0#usize
  then
    let j1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub j 1#usize)
    let i ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shl remainder 32#u32)
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize quotient j1
    let i2 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i1)
    let dividend ← lift (i ||| i2)
    let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i4 ← dividend / i3
    let i5 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i4)
    let quotient1 ← Array.update quotient j1 i5
    let i6 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let remainder1 ← dividend % i6
    ok (cont (quotient1, remainder1, j1))
  else ok (done (quotient, remainder))

def host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop1.body
  (quotient : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  (d : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × (Array Std.U32 8#usize) ×
    Std.Usize) ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × (Array Std.U32 8#usize)))
  := do
  if d < 8#usize
  then
    let (quotient1, remainder) ←
      host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop1_loop0 quotient 0#u64 8#usize
    let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 remainder)
    let digits1 ← Array.update digits d i
    let d1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add d 1#usize)
    ok (cont (quotient1, digits1, d1))
  else ok (done (quotient, digits))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::low_base_p_digits]: loop body 3:

@[rust_loop_body]
def host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop2.body
  (check : Std.Usize) : Result (ControlFlow Std.Usize Unit) := do
  if check < 8#usize
  then
    let check1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add check 1#usize)
    ok (cont check1)
  else ok (done ())

  loop
    (fun check1 => host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop2.body check1)
    check

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::low_base_p_digits]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 3:0-30:1 -/
def host_sampler.low_base_p_digits
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32)
  := do
  let quotient := Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u32
  let quotient1 ← host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop0 block quotient 0#usize
  let digits := Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u32
  let (quotient2, digits1) ←
    host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop1 quotient1 digits 0#usize
  host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop2 1#usize
  let i ← Array.index_usize quotient2 0#usize
  ok (digits1, i)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::decode8]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 32:0-34:1 -/
def host_sampler.decode8
  (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let o ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs digits
  core.option.Option.unwrap o

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::add_small_base_p]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 40:4-45:5 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def host_sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body
  (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (addend : Std.U32) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32 × Std.Usize) ((Array
    Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32))
  := do
  if i < 8#usize
  then
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize digits i
    let i2 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i1)
    let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from addend)
    let sum ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i2 i3)
    let i4 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i5 ← sum % i4
    let i6 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i5)
    let digits1 ← Array.update digits i i6
    let i7 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i8 ← sum / i7
    let addend1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i8)
    let i9 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
    ok (cont (digits1, addend1, i9))
  else ok (done (digits, addend))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::add_small_base_p]: loop 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 40:4-45:5 -/
@[rust_loop]
def host_sampler.add_small_base_p_loop
  (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (addend : Std.U32) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (digits1, addend1, i1) => host_sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body
      digits1 addend1 i1)
    (digits, addend, i)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::add_small_base_p]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 38:0-48:1 -/
def host_sampler.add_small_base_p
  (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (addend : Std.U32) :
  Result (Bool × (Array Std.U32 8#usize))
  := do
  let (digits1, addend1) ←
    host_sampler.add_small_base_p_loop digits addend 0#usize
  ok (addend1 != 0#u32, digits1)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::gamma_sample]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 61:0-69:1
    Visibility: public -/
def host_sampler.gamma_sample
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let (digits, quotient) ← host_sampler.low_base_p_digits block
  let i ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_add quotient 1#u32)
  let (wrapped, digits1) ← host_sampler.add_small_base_p digits i
  let digits2 ←
    if wrapped
    then
      do
      let (_, digits3) ← host_sampler.add_small_base_p digits1 1#u32
      ok digits3
    else ok digits1
  host_sampler.decode8 digits2

def host_sampler.ordinary_sample
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let (digits, _) ← host_sampler.low_base_p_digits block
  host_sampler.decode8 digits

end PV_B2_C_Sampler

-- Component PV_B2_ArrayDigits.lean
section
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_B2_C_ArrayDigits
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def limb (a : Array U32 8#usize) (i : Fin 8) : U32 :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by rw [a.property]; exact i.isLt)

def canonical (a : Array U32 8#usize) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin 8, (limb a i).val < 2147483647

def raw (a : Array U32 8#usize) : PV_B2_C_249.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact :=
  ⟨⟨⟨limb a 0,limb a 1⟩,⟨limb a 2,limb a 3⟩⟩,
   ⟨⟨limb a 4,limb a 5⟩,⟨limb a 6,limb a 7⟩⟩⟩

theorem read (a : Array U32 8#usize) (i : Usize) (h : i.val < 8) :
    Array.index_usize a i = ok (limb a ⟨i.val,h⟩) := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_usize_spec a i (by
      change i.val < a.val.length
      rw [a.property]
      exact h))
  have he : x = limb a ⟨i.val,h⟩ := by simpa only [limb] using hv
  simpa only [he] using hx

/-- The copied checked constructor agrees with raw limb assembly exactly on
its canonical domain. The domain is proved for sampler outputs separately. -/
theorem decode (a : Array U32 8#usize) (hc : canonical a) :
    PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.decode8 a = ok (raw a) := by
  have hn (i : Fin 8) : ¬ limb a i >= 2147483647#u32 := by
    change ¬ 2147483647 ≤ (limb a i).val
    exact Nat.not_le_of_gt (hc i)
  unfold PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.decode8
    PV_B2_C_Sampler.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs
  simp only [PV_B2_C_Sampler.aspis_core.field.P]
  rw [read a 0#usize (by decide),read a 1#usize (by decide),
    read a 2#usize (by decide),read a 3#usize (by decide),
    read a 4#usize (by decide),read a 5#usize (by decide),
    read a 6#usize (by decide),read a 7#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,hn,if_false]
  rfl
#print axioms read
#print axioms decode
end PV_B2_C_ArrayDigits

end
-- Component PV_B2_ByteShape.lean
section
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_B2_C_ByteShape
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

def tail2 (c d : U8) : BitVec 24 :=
  c.bv.setWidth 24 ||| (((d.bv.setWidth 16) <<< 8).setWidth 24)
def tail3 (b c d : U8) : BitVec 32 :=
  b.bv.setWidth 32 ||| ((tail2 c d <<< 8).setWidth 32)
def assembled (a b c d : U8) : BitVec 32 :=
  a.bv.setWidth 32 ||| (tail3 b c d <<< 8)

/-- Four-byte parser shape, isolated before any arithmetic normalization. -/
theorem source (a b c d : U8) :
    core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) = (⟨assembled a b c d⟩ : U32) := by
  simp [core.num.U32.from_le_bytes,Array.make,BitVec.fromLEBytes,assembled,tail2,tail3]
#print axioms source
end PV_B2_C_ByteShape

end
-- Component PV_B2_ByteWord.lean
section
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_B2_C_ByteWord
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

def word (a b c d : U8) : U32 :=
  (UScalar.cast .U32 a) ||| (U32.wrapping_shl (UScalar.cast .U32 b) 8#u32) |||
  (U32.wrapping_shl (UScalar.cast .U32 c) 16#u32) |||
  (U32.wrapping_shl (UScalar.cast .U32 d) 24#u32)

def bits (a b c d : U8) : BitVec 32 :=
  a.bv.setWidth 32 ||| (b.bv.setWidth 32 <<< 8) |||
  (c.bv.setWidth 32 <<< 16) ||| (d.bv.setWidth 32 <<< 24)

theorem machine (a b c d : U8) : word a b c d = (⟨bits a b c d⟩ : U32) := by
  rfl
#print axioms machine
end PV_B2_C_ByteWord

end

namespace PV_B2_C_ByteBits
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

theorem shape (a b c d : U8) :
    PV_B2_C_ByteWord.bits a b c d = PV_B2_C_ByteShape.assembled a b c d := by
  unfold PV_B2_C_ByteWord.bits PV_B2_C_ByteShape.assembled PV_B2_C_ByteShape.tail3 PV_B2_C_ByteShape.tail2
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i < 32
  · interval_cases i <;>
      simp [BitVec.getLsbD_or,BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth,BitVec.getLsbD_shiftLeft]
  · simp [BitVec.getLsbD_of_ge _ _ (by omega : 32 ≤ i)]

theorem source (a b c d : U8) : PV_B2_C_ByteWord.word a b c d =
    core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) := by
  rw [PV_B2_C_ByteWord.machine,PV_B2_C_ByteShape.source,shape]
#print axioms shape
#print axioms source
end PV_B2_C_ByteBits

abbrev aspis_core.field.M31 := PV_B2_C_249.aspis_core.field.M31

abbrev aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact := PV_B2_C_249.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
/-- [aspis_core::field::P]
    Source: '/home/dombarker/project-offloads/codex-cx-prover-rw-20261023/src/crates/aspis-core/src/field.rs', lines 19:0-19:16
    Name pattern: [aspis_core::field::P]
    Visibility: public -/
@[global_simps, irreducible, rust_const "aspis_core::field::P"]
def aspis_core.field.P : Std.U32 := 2147483647#u32

/-- [prover_rw_success_p8::sampler_owned::qm31_div_pass]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'sampler_owned.rs', lines 5:1-10:2
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def sampler_owned.qm31_div_pass_loop.body
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (remainder : Std.U64) (j : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64 × Std.Usize) ((Array
    Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64))
  := do
  if j > 0#usize
  then
    let j1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub j 1#usize)
    let i ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shl remainder 32#u32)
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize rank j1
    let i2 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i1)
    let dividend ← lift (i ||| i2)
    let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i4 ← dividend / i3
    let i5 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i4)
    let rank1 ← Array.update rank j1 i5
    let i6 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let remainder1 ← dividend % i6
    ok (cont (rank1, remainder1, j1))
  else ok (done (rank, remainder))

/-- [prover_rw_success_p8::sampler_owned::qm31_div_pass]: loop 0:
    Source: 'sampler_owned.rs', lines 5:1-10:2
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop]
def sampler_owned.qm31_div_pass_loop
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (remainder : Std.U64) (j : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (rank1, remainder1, j1) => sampler_owned.qm31_div_pass_loop.body rank1
      remainder1 j1)
    (rank, remainder, j)

/-- [prover_rw_success_p8::sampler_owned::qm31_div_pass]:
    Source: 'sampler_owned.rs', lines 3:0-12:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sampler_owned.qm31_div_pass
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32)
  := do
  let (rank1, remainder) ←
    sampler_owned.qm31_div_pass_loop rank 0#u64 8#usize
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 remainder)
  ok (rank1, i)

/-- [prover_rw_success_p8::sampler_owned::low_base_p_digits]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'sampler_owned.rs', lines 15:1-19:2
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits_loop0.body
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.Usize) (Array Std.U32
    8#usize))
  := do
  if i < 8#usize
  then
    let start ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i)
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize block start
    let i2 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add start 1#usize)
    let i3 ← Array.index_usize block i2
    let i4 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add start 2#usize)
    let i5 ← Array.index_usize block i4
    let i6 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add start 3#usize)
    let i7 ← Array.index_usize block i6
    let i8 ←
      lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [ i1, i3, i5, i7 ]))
    let rank1 ← Array.update rank i i8
    let i9 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
    ok (cont (rank1, i9))
  else ok (done rank)

/-- [prover_rw_success_p8::sampler_owned::low_base_p_digits]: loop 0:
    Source: 'sampler_owned.rs', lines 15:1-19:2
    Visibility: public -/

def sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits_loop0
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (rank1, i1) => sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits_loop0.body block rank1
      i1)
    (rank, i)

/-- [prover_rw_success_p8::sampler_owned::low_base_p_digits]: loop body 1:
    Source: 'sampler_owned.rs', lines 21:1-24:2
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits_loop1.body
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × (Array Std.U32 8#usize) ×
    Std.Usize) ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × (Array Std.U32 8#usize)))
  := do
  if i < 8#usize
  then
    let (quotient, digit) ← sampler_owned.qm31_div_pass rank
    let digits1 ← Array.update digits i digit
    let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
    ok (cont (quotient, digits1, i1))
  else ok (done (rank, digits))

    Source: 'sampler_owned.rs', lines 21:1-24:2
    Visibility: public -/

def sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits_loop1
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × (Array Std.U32 8#usize))
  := do
  loop
    (fun (rank1, digits1, i1) => sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits_loop1.body
      rank1 digits1 i1)
    (rank, digits, i)

/-- [prover_rw_success_p8::sampler_owned::low_base_p_digits]:
    Source: 'sampler_owned.rs', lines 13:0-26:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32)
  := do
  let rank := Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u32
  let rank1 ← sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits_loop0 block rank 0#usize
  let digits := Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u32
  let (rank2, digits1) ←
    sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits_loop1 rank1 digits 0#usize
  let i ← Array.index_usize rank2 0#usize
  ok (digits1, i)

end PV_B2_C_OrdinaryReference

/-- Release compilation removes assertions but keeps this seven-step empty loop.
It terminates without affecting the full Result of the digit pass. -/
theorem source : run 1#usize = ok () := by
  calc
    run 1#usize = run 2#usize := by
      have hn : Usize.wrapping_add 1#usize 1#usize = 2#usize := by
        apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
        rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
        have hs : (1#usize).val + (1#usize).val < (9#usize).val := by scalar_tac
        have hb : (9#usize).val < UScalar.size .Usize := by
          simpa only [UScalar.val,UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits] using (9#usize).bv.isLt
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_trans hs hb)]
        rfl
      simpa only [hn] using step 1#usize (by decide)
    _ = run 3#usize := by
      have hn : Usize.wrapping_add 2#usize 1#usize = 3#usize := by
        apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
        rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
        have hs : (2#usize).val + (1#usize).val < (9#usize).val := by scalar_tac
        have hb : (9#usize).val < UScalar.size .Usize := by
          simpa only [UScalar.val,UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits] using (9#usize).bv.isLt
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_trans hs hb)]
        rfl
      simpa only [hn] using step 2#usize (by decide)
    _ = run 4#usize := by
      have hn : Usize.wrapping_add 3#usize 1#usize = 4#usize := by
        apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
        rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
        have hs : (3#usize).val + (1#usize).val < (9#usize).val := by scalar_tac
        have hb : (9#usize).val < UScalar.size .Usize := by
          simpa only [UScalar.val,UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits] using (9#usize).bv.isLt
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_trans hs hb)]
        rfl
      simpa only [hn] using step 3#usize (by decide)
    _ = run 5#usize := by
      have hn : Usize.wrapping_add 4#usize 1#usize = 5#usize := by
        apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
        rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
        have hs : (4#usize).val + (1#usize).val < (9#usize).val := by scalar_tac
        have hb : (9#usize).val < UScalar.size .Usize := by
          simpa only [UScalar.val,UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits] using (9#usize).bv.isLt
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_trans hs hb)]
        rfl
      simpa only [hn] using step 4#usize (by decide)
    _ = run 6#usize := by
      have hn : Usize.wrapping_add 5#usize 1#usize = 6#usize := by
        apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
        rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
        have hs : (5#usize).val + (1#usize).val < (9#usize).val := by scalar_tac
        have hb : (9#usize).val < UScalar.size .Usize := by

    _ = run 7#usize := by
      have hn : Usize.wrapping_add 6#usize 1#usize = 7#usize := by
        apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
        rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]

/-- Exact complete-Result numeric recurrence transport; arbitrary32-byte input. -/
theorem source (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
    PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.low_base_p_digits block =
      PV_B2_C_OrdinaryReference.sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits block := by
  have hb : PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop0 =
      PV_B2_C_OrdinaryReference.sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits_loop0 := by
    funext b q i
    exact PV_B2_C_Bytes.loop b q i
  have hd : PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop1 =
      PV_B2_C_OrdinaryReference.sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits_loop1 := by
    funext q d i
    exact PV_B2_C_Digits.loop q d i
  unfold PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.low_base_p_digits
    PV_B2_C_OrdinaryReference.sampler_owned.low_base_p_digits
  simp only [hb,hd]
  apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro q _
  apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
  rintro ⟨q,d⟩ _
  have hc : PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop2 1#usize = ok () :=
    PV_B2_C_ReleaseCheck.source

-- Component PV_B2_CheckedDiv.lean

namespace R1Z.PV_B2_C_CheckedDiv
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow PV_B2_C_MachineArithmetic
abbrev N := _root_.PV_B2_C_OrdinaryReference.sampler_owned.qm31_div_pass_loop.body

theorem body (rank : Array U32 8#usize) (r : U64) (j : Usize) :
    N rank r j = O rank r j := by

  · have hj : (1#usize).val ≤ j.val := by change 0 < j.val at h; scalar_tac

      _root_.PV_B2_C_OrdinaryReference.aspis_core.field.P,AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.P,lift]
  · simp only [if_neg h]

    N block rank i = O block rank i := by

    AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits_loop0.body

    obtain ⟨start,hm,hv⟩ := spec_imp_exists
      (Usize.mul_spec (x := 4#usize) (y := i) (by scalar_tac))
    have hs : start.val = 4*i.val := by simpa using hv
    have he : Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i = start :=
      Result.ok.inj ((mul_exact 4#usize i (by scalar_tac)).symm.trans hm)
    simp only [if_pos h,lift,he,hm,bind_tc_ok,
      add_exact start 1#usize (by scalar_tac),
      add_exact start 2#usize (by scalar_tac),
      add_exact start 3#usize (by scalar_tac),
      add_exact i 1#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  · simp only [if_neg h]

/-- Complete Result and exact numeric digits of the applied copy's division
recurrence, for every256-bit block. No success premise is assumed. -/
theorem source (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
    ∃ digits : Array U32 8#usize, ∃ quotient : U32,
      PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.low_base_p_digits block = ok (digits,quotient) ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerIndexedGeneratedBridge.values digits =
        AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.ordinaryDigits (AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank.rank block) ∧
      AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits.digitsValue AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P
        (AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.ordinaryDigits (AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank.rank block)) =
        AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank.rank block % AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P^8 := by
  obtain ⟨outRank,digits,q,hlow,_,hvalues,hresidue,_⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerIndexedOrdinaryBridgeV1.ordinary_sample_candidate block
  refine ⟨digits,q,?_,hvalues,hresidue⟩
  rw [PV_B2_C_LowDigits.source,R1Z.PV_B2_C_CheckedDigits.digits]
  exact hlow
#print axioms source
end PV_B2_C_RankDigits

-- Component PV_B2_ordinary_sample.lean
section
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_B2_C_ordinary_sample
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds

/-- Canonicality is a symbolic consequence of the recurrence, for any base,
length and input rank. No concrete256-bit recurrence is reduced. -/
theorem low_canonical (base n x : Nat) (positive : 0 < base) :
    ∀ d, d ∈ AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.lowDigits base n x → d < base := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero =>
    intro d hd
    simp only [AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.lowDigits,List.not_mem_nil] at hd
  | succ n ih =>
    intro d hd
    simp only [AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.lowDigits,List.mem_cons] at hd
    rcases hd with rfl | hd
    · exact Nat.mod_lt _ positive
    · exact ih _ d hd

/-- Exact complete Result of the normalized source emission on every block,
including its exact canonical base-P digit value and rank residue. This does
not install the native callback or assert iterator/allocator association. -/
theorem op250_source (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
    ∃ digits : Array U32 8#usize,
      PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.ordinary_sample block = ok (PV_B2_C_ArrayDigits.raw digits) ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerIndexedGeneratedBridge.values digits =
        AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.ordinaryDigits (AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank.rank block) := by
  obtain ⟨digits,q,hlow,hvalues,_⟩ := PV_B2_C_RankDigits.source block
  have hc : PV_B2_C_ArrayDigits.canonical digits := by
    intro i
    have hm : (PV_B2_C_ArrayDigits.limb digits i).val ∈
        AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerIndexedGeneratedBridge.values digits := by
      change (PV_B2_C_ArrayDigits.limb digits i).val ∈ digits.val.map UScalar.val
      apply List.mem_map.mpr
      exact ⟨_,List.getElem_mem (by rw [digits.property]; exact i.isLt),rfl⟩
    rw [hvalues] at hm
    change (PV_B2_C_ArrayDigits.limb digits i).val < P
    exact low_canonical P 8 _ P_pos _ hm
  refine ⟨digits,?_,hvalues⟩
  simp only [PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.ordinary_sample,hlow,bind_tc_ok]
  exact PV_B2_C_ArrayDigits.decode digits hc
#print axioms low_canonical
#print axioms op250_source
end PV_B2_C_ordinary_sample

end

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::add_small_base_p]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 40:4-45:5 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def host_sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body
  (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (addend : Std.U32) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32 × Std.Usize) ((Array
    Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32))
  := do
  if i < 8#usize
  then
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize digits i
    let i2 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i1)
    let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from addend)
    let sum ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i2 i3)
    let i4 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i5 ← sum % i4
    let i6 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i5)
    let digits1 ← Array.update digits i i6
    let i7 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i8 ← sum / i7
    let addend1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i8)
    let i9 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
    ok (cont (digits1, addend1, i9))
  else ok (done (digits, addend))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::add_small_base_p]: loop 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 40:4-45:5 -/
@[rust_loop]
def host_sampler.add_small_base_p_loop
  (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (addend : Std.U32) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (digits1, addend1, i1) => host_sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body
      digits1 addend1 i1)
    (digits, addend, i)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::add_small_base_p]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 38:0-48:1 -/
def host_sampler.add_small_base_p
  (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (addend : Std.U32) :
  Result (Bool × (Array Std.U32 8#usize))
  := do
  let (digits1, addend1) ←
    host_sampler.add_small_base_p_loop digits addend 0#usize
  ok (addend1 != 0#u32, digits1)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::gamma_sample]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 61:0-69:1
    Visibility: public -/
def host_sampler.gamma_sample
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let (digits, quotient) ← host_sampler.low_base_p_digits block
  let i ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_add quotient 1#u32)
  let (wrapped, digits1) ← host_sampler.add_small_base_p digits i
  let digits2 ←
    if wrapped
    then
      do
      let (_, digits3) ← host_sampler.add_small_base_p digits1 1#u32
      ok digits3
    else ok digits1
  host_sampler.decode8 digits2

end PV_B2_C_249

-- Component PV_B2_SamplerCarrier.lean
section
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_B2_C_SamplerCarrier
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Raw := PV_B2_C_249.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
abbrev Native := PV_B2_C_249.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact

def toNative (v : Raw) : Native :=
  ⟨⟨⟨v.c0.c0.a,v.c0.c0.b⟩,⟨v.c0.c1.a,v.c0.c1.b⟩⟩,
   ⟨⟨v.c1.c0.a,v.c1.c0.b⟩,⟨v.c1.c1.a,v.c1.c1.b⟩⟩⟩
def fromNative (v : Native) : Raw :=
  ⟨⟨⟨v.c0.c0.a,v.c0.c0.b⟩,⟨v.c0.c1.a,v.c0.c1.b⟩⟩,
   ⟨⟨v.c1.c0.a,v.c1.c0.b⟩,⟨v.c1.c1.a,v.c1.c1.b⟩⟩⟩
def mapResult {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : Result α → Result β
  | .ok v => .ok (f v)
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

theorem roundtrip (v : Native) : toNative (fromNative v) = v := by cases v; rfl
theorem roundtrip_raw (v : Raw) : fromNative (toNative v) = v := by cases v; rfl

/-- A field-for-field carrier change preserves both failure tags and divergence. -/
theorem map_bind {α β γ : Type} (f : β → γ) (x : Result α) (k : α → Result β) :
    mapResult f (x >>= k) = (x >>= fun a => mapResult f (k a)) := by cases x <;> rfl

#print axioms roundtrip
#print axioms roundtrip_raw
#print axioms map_bind
end PV_B2_C_SamplerCarrier

end
end

theorem constructor_transport (a : Array U32 8#usize) :
    mapResult (Option.map toNative)
      (PV_B2_C_249.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs a) =
      PV_B2_C_Sampler.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs a := by
  unfold PV_B2_C_249.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs
    PV_B2_C_Sampler.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs
  simp only [PV_B2_C_249.aspis_core.field.P,PV_B2_C_Sampler.aspis_core.field.P]
  rw [map_bind]
  apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro x0 _
  by_cases h0 : x0 >= 2147483647#u32
  · simp only [if_pos h0,mapResult,Option.map]
  · simp only [if_neg h0]
    rw [map_bind]
    apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro x1 _
    by_cases h1 : x1 >= 2147483647#u32
    · simp only [if_pos h1,mapResult,Option.map]
    · simp only [if_neg h1]
      rw [map_bind]
      apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
      intro x2 _
      by_cases h2 : x2 >= 2147483647#u32
      · simp only [if_pos h2,mapResult,Option.map]
      · simp only [if_neg h2]
        rw [map_bind]
        apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
        intro x3 _
        by_cases h3 : x3 >= 2147483647#u32
        · simp only [if_pos h3,mapResult,Option.map]
        · simp only [if_neg h3]
          rw [map_bind]
          apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
          intro x4 _
          by_cases h4 : x4 >= 2147483647#u32
          · simp only [if_pos h4,mapResult,Option.map]
          · simp only [if_neg h4]
            rw [map_bind]
            apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
            intro x5 _
            by_cases h5 : x5 >= 2147483647#u32
            · simp only [if_pos h5,mapResult,Option.map]
            · simp only [if_neg h5]
              rw [map_bind]
              apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
              intro x6 _
              by_cases h6 : x6 >= 2147483647#u32
              · simp only [if_pos h6,mapResult,Option.map]
              · simp only [if_neg h6]

                intro x7 _
                by_cases h7 : x7 >= 2147483647#u32
                · simp only [if_pos h7,mapResult,Option.map]
                · simp only [if_neg h7]
                  rfl

-- Component PV_B2_DecodeResult.lean
section
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_B2_C_DecodeResult
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_B2_C_SamplerCarrier

theorem unwrap (o : Option Raw) :
    mapResult toNative (core.option.Option.unwrap o) =
      core.option.Option.unwrap (Option.map toNative o) := by cases o <;> rfl

/-- The checked limb decoder preserves panic and divergence as well as values. -/
theorem source (a : Array U32 8#usize) :
    mapResult toNative (PV_B2_C_249.host_sampler.decode8 a) =
      PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.decode8 a := by
  unfold PV_B2_C_249.host_sampler.decode8 PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.decode8
  rw [map_bind]
  have hc := PV_B2_C_Decode.constructor_transport a
  cases h : PV_B2_C_249.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs a with
  | ok o =>
    rw [h] at hc
    simp only [mapResult] at hc
    rw [←hc]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact unwrap o
  | fail e =>
    rw [h] at hc
    simp only [mapResult] at hc
    rw [←hc]
    rfl
  | div =>
    rw [h] at hc
    simp only [mapResult] at hc
    rw [←hc]
    rfl
#print axioms unwrap
#print axioms source
end PV_B2_C_DecodeResult

end

-- Component PV_B2_GammaCarrier.lean
section
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_B2_C_GammaCarrier
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_B2_C_SamplerCarrier
abbrev Digits := Array U32 8#usize

def rest (wrapped : Bool) (digits : Digits) : Result Digits :=
  if wrapped then do
    let (_,out) ← PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.add_small_base_p digits 1#u32
    ok out
  else ok digits

theorem tail_source (r : Result Digits) :
    mapResult toNative (do let d ← r; PV_B2_C_249.host_sampler.decode8 d) =
      (do let d ← r; PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.decode8 d) := by
  rw [map_bind]
  apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro d _
  exact PV_B2_C_DecodeResult.source d

theorem after_low (digits : Digits) (q : U32) :
    mapResult toNative (do
      let i ← lift (U32.wrapping_add q 1#u32)
      let (wrapped,digits1) ← PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.add_small_base_p digits i
      let digits2 ← rest wrapped digits1
      PV_B2_C_249.host_sampler.decode8 digits2) =
    (do
      let i ← lift (U32.wrapping_add q 1#u32)
      let (wrapped,digits1) ← PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.add_small_base_p digits i
      let digits2 ← rest wrapped digits1
      PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.decode8 digits2) := by
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok,map_bind]
  apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
  rintro ⟨wrapped,digits1⟩ _
  exact tail_source (rest wrapped digits1)

/-- Full Result equality between the unmodified raw gamma emission and its
native-carrier presentation, for every byte block. This is not copy/original
native equivalence or the gamma rank law. -/
theorem source (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
    mapResult toNative (PV_B2_C_249.host_sampler.gamma_sample block) =
      PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.gamma_sample block := by
  unfold PV_B2_C_249.host_sampler.gamma_sample PV_B2_C_Sampler.host_sampler.gamma_sample
  simp only [PV_B2_C_SamplerHelpers.low,PV_B2_C_SamplerHelpers.small,map_bind]
  apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
  rintro ⟨digits,q⟩ _
  exact after_low digits q
#print axioms tail_source
#print axioms after_low
#print axioms source
end PV_B2_C_GammaCarrier

end
